lean.statement:
theorem result
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] :
    let S := {w : E // ‖w‖ = 1}
    let c : S × S → ℝ := fun z => Real.arccos ⟪z.1.1,z.2.1⟫_ℝ
    Continuous c ∧ Measurable c ∧
      (∀ u v : S, 0 ≤ c (u,v) ∧ c (u,v) ≤ Real.pi ∧
        c (u,v) = InnerProductGeometry.angle u.1 v.1 ∧
        ‖u.1-v.1‖ ≤ c (u,v) ∧
        (c (u,v) = 0 ↔ u = v) ∧ c (u,v) = c (v,u)) ∧
      ∀ u v w : S, c (u,w) ≤ c (u,v)+c (v,w)
approved_definition_context: The subtype {w : E // norm(w)=1} has ambient representatives obtained by coercion and inherits its topology and measurable structure. Product spaces use the product topology and sigma algebra.

InnerProductGeometry.angle of two real inner-product vectors is arccos of their real inner product divided by the product of their norms. Real division is totalized in Lean. Real.arccos denotes the principal real inverse cosine.
Continuous and Measurable are properties of the displayed function. Equality between subtype points means equality of ambient representatives; norm is the ambient norm.
